title: pyrrocoma crocea
intro: Pyrrocoma crocea, commonly known as Pyrrocoma, is a flowering plant species within the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which can aid in wound healing and infection prevention. The therapeutic actions of Pyrrocoma include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties, making it a potential treatment for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Pyrrocoma include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
